messages:
marco: starting onboarding for umbra11b (hf->redwood convert). quick int4 smoke shows PPL +20% vs gemma-lite. attaching logs. anyone seen head-perm issues after convert?
anya: what convert flags? rotary type/freq, preserve_head_order? tokenizer normalizer?
marco: convert detected llama-rotary, freq_scale=1.0, n_heads=88, head_dim=128. default rewiring applied (headwise-shim). tokenizer: upstream HF tokenizer, normalizer disabled.
samir: we've seen head-reorder cause per-head phase drift. run rotary-compare and tokenizer-audit.
lucy: tokenizer-audit: `tools/tokenizer-audit --model ./umbra11b --gold gemma-lite --flags nfkc,casefold` — check remapped tokens, especially zero-widths.
marco: audit: 27 tokens remapped (ZWJ chars & punctuation). rotary-compare shows heads 24-35 diff ~0.1, others <1e-4. likely head permutation.
anya: try convert with `--preserve-head-order` and rerun nfkc. also lower batch to 4 for smoke (got OOM at 8).
ci-bot: :warning: job 4880000000-smoke failed OOM on gpu-03 at batch8.
marco: rerun preserve-head-order + nfkc + batch4. smoke finished: PPL now +3.5% vs gemma-lite. generation spot-check better but still occasional premature EOS.
samir: bisect quant kernels tomorrow: int4 per-channel vs per-tensor, fallback some proj layers to fp16. prepare repro prompts and dump token windows around EOS.
lucy: create minimal repro (10 prompts) and attach `decode_debug` output. schedule bisect 9am PT.
marco: repro created (umbra-eos-repro.jsonl), queued bisect. will post artifacts. :coffee:
